title: 1970s film photo
note: A stylized image, beyond the training data; the model saw it at 1.25 times its assumed size (lemons about 7 to 8 cm).

facts.what: A lemon (elastic, 100 kPa) dropped onto a jelly mould (elastic): it lands, bounces and comes to rest on top
facts.extra: A known limit: the mould and the dropped lemon stay slightly deformed at rest (strain about 0.12, against 0.02 for the untouched second lemon, which is drawn from the photo).
facts.sel: Seed 0; 7 of 8 seeds pass the selection rule; no overlap and no entry into photo-only objects
